positions.title: Lead Front End Developer - Bank Page
positions.description:
•	Led the complete redesign of Citi’s Checkings, Savings, and Loan pages.
•	Built fast, reusable, and extensible components using Angular and Typescript.
•	Oversaw and planned all our pages’ monthly releases impacting millions of customers.
•	Coordinated the integration of multiple teams' modules within our codebase, optimizing for page performance.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Developed the angular pages of the Bank team.
•	Built multiple components required by the business team.
•	Managed multiple language content through a CMS.
•	Tasked to fix production issues.
•	Worked on a company side project to increase productivity.

positions.title: Technology Leadership Program Intern
positions.description:
• 	Created a comprehensive dashboard to visualize and monitor teams’ performance at Citi using Angular & Node.
• 	Built services which collected, filtered, and combined data from several external tools to support the dashboard.
• 	Redeveloped the Citi’s intern recruiting web page migrating a legacy stack to Angular.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
• 	Created a design system library using React to support common UI components across the enterprise.
• 	Developed front end enhancements to our team’s web page in UltiPro
• 	Created an algorithm to display the organization chart of a company on a pdf file in C#.

positions.title: Developer
positions.locationName: Gainesville y alrededores, Florida, Estados Unidos
positions.description:
•	First real interaction with paying customers
•	Learned the basics of web server-client interaction 
•	Had to meet deadlines and mold the product to satisfy the customers’ needs

projects.title: CrowTrends
projects.description:
•	Created a fully responsive dashboard that showcases the stock market sentiment using React & Next.js.
•	Architected the authentication layer end to end including multiple social media logins.
•	Developed interactive data visualization components with D3.js.
•	Created services to fetch, parse, aggregate, and store market data utilizing .NET Core & MongoDB.
•	Built an array of service workers to collect sentiment and market data at different time intervals

projects.title: Roads and Boats game
projects.description:
•	Replica of the board game “Roads and Boats”, developed in Java
•	Developed the file reader and file writer for saving and loading the map in the editor
•	Designed and developed the whole controller interface of the game which manages the model and view of the game
